Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Ah, I see. Well, I cannot say that I am not a little disappointed.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: It is not your fault ! Mes attentes-- I thought that maybe--

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: What I want to say is that I do not have a lot of opportunités to find kinship. For the same reason that I am unable to make my mark on le monde.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: I was hoping that ... erm, not that you are easy to--

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Perhaps I should leave you to it. It would be awkward for me, and you may have better luck with some of the other trees.

Line.Text: Au revoir. You will be in my thoughts.
